facts.sentence: The policy design aligns coverage with expected increases in family or financial obligations later in the term.

facts.name: Return of Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the insured survives the full term, and all required base premiums are paid, all base premiums paid will be refunded.

facts.name: Scheduled Increase Without Underwriting
facts.sentence: No new underwriting is required for the scheduled increase in death benefit.

facts.name: Death Benefit: Years 1–10
facts.sentence: If death occurs in policy years 1 through 10, the death benefit payment is $250,000.

facts.name: Increased Death Benefit (Years 11–20)
facts.sentence: If death occurs in policy years 11 through 20, the death benefit payment is $400,000.

facts.name: Rider Benefits Add-On
facts.sentence: Optional rider benefits, if present, are payable in addition to the base death benefit.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Beneficiary claims require standard proof.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $2,040.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due on April 10 each year.

facts.name: Level Premiums for 20 Years
facts.sentence: Premiums remain level for the entire 20-year term.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for premium payments is 31 days.

facts.name: Reinstatement ROP Credit Reduction
facts.sentence: If a premium is paid after a lapse and coverage is reinstated, that policy year earns only 50% Return of Premium (ROP) credit for that year's premium.

facts.name: End-of-Term Return Payment
facts.sentence: For policyholders who survive until the end of the 20-year term and maintain active coverage, the insurer will pay $40,800 to the policy owner.

facts.name: Zero Refund in Early Surrender
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered during years 1–5, the owner receives 0% of the paid base premiums.

facts.name: ROP: Surrender Years 6–10
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered during years 6–10, the owner receives 30% of the paid base premiums.

facts.name: Return of Premium: Years 11–14
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered during years 11–14, the owner receives 55% of the paid base premiums.

facts.name: Return of Premium: Years 15–18
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered during years 15–18, the owner receives 80% of the paid base premiums.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Refund
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered during years 19–20, the owner receives 100% of the paid base premiums.

facts.name: Step-Up Does Not Affect ROP
facts.sentence: The step-up in death benefit does not affect the Return of Premium (ROP) percentage.

facts.name: Rider Premium Exclusion
facts.sentence: Rider premiums are excluded from the calculation of the Return of Premium (ROP) amount.

facts.name: Rider Benefits Add-On
facts.sentence: Optional rider benefits, if applicable, are payable in addition to the base death benefit.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: Beneficiary claims require standard proof of death.

facts.name: Proof of Identity Requirement
facts.sentence: Beneficiary claims require standard proof of identity.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout

facts.name: Conversion Eligibility Before Year 15

facts.name: Conversion Before Age 65

facts.name: Conversion Timing Eligibility
facts.sentence: The earliest possible date for conversion to permanent insurance is the earlier of policy year 15 or age 65.

facts.name: Conversion to Face Amount
facts.sentence: Conversion may apply to the face amount currently in force under the policy.

facts.name: Full Conversion Forfeits Future ROP
facts.sentence: Full conversion results in the forfeiture of future Return of Premium (ROP).

facts.name: Partial Conversion & ROP Reduction
facts.sentence: Partial conversion leads to a proportional reduction in future ROP.

facts.sentence: Available riders at issue include Waiver of Premium.

facts.name: Riders at Issue: Accidental Death
facts.sentence: Available riders at issue include Accidental Death.

facts.name: Chronic Illness Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Available riders at issue include Chronic Illness Acceleration.

facts.name: Reduced death benefit
facts.sentence: Accelerated death benefits reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: ROP Reduction via Accelerated Benefits
facts.sentence: Accelerated death benefits may reduce any future surrender ROP proportionally.

facts.name: No Loan Feature
facts.sentence: This policy does not have a loan feature.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Limit
facts.sentence: Suicide within 24 months from issue limits liability to premiums paid for the base policy.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy is contestable for two years from issue due to material misrepresentation.

facts.name: No Exclusion for Lawful Activities
facts.sentence: No exclusion applies for lawful travel, occupation, or sports unless specifically provided by a rider.

facts.name: Reinstatement Time Limit
facts.sentence: Reinstatement may be requested within five years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires satisfactory evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums with five percent annual interest.

facts.name: Reinstatement Step-Up Continuity
facts.sentence: Reinstatement does not change the scheduled step-up date.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Owner Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The owner may convert the policy.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy for its vested ROP value.

facts.name: Owner Election Notice Requirement
facts.sentence: Written notice is required for all owner elections.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age adjusts insurance to the amount purchasable by the premium actually paid.

facts.name: Misstatement Adjustment Rule
facts.sentence: Misstatement of sex adjusts insurance to the amount purchasable by the premium actually paid.

facts.sentence: This policy has no loan value.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: This policy allows no partial withdrawals.

facts.name: Equal Share Distribution
facts.sentence: Each surviving child receives an equal share of the contingent benefit.

facts.name: Return of Premium Term Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is classified as a Return of Premium Term Life policy.

facts.name: Return of Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the insured survives the full policy term, they will receive a refund of 100% of paid base premiums.

facts.name: Return of Premium Condition
facts.sentence: To qualify for the return of premiums, all required base premiums must be paid during the policy term.

facts.name: Joint Ownership Rights
facts.sentence: Joint ownership allows either owner to exercise policy rights while both owners are alive.

facts.name: Joint Owner Restrictions
facts.sentence: A written restriction signed by both joint owners can limit the ability of either owner to act independently.

facts.name: Survivor Becomes Sole Owner
facts.sentence: Upon the death of one joint owner, the surviving joint owner automatically becomes the sole owner.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer After Death
facts.sentence: The change in ownership upon death of a joint owner is subject to any recorded assignments.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Amount
facts.sentence: If the insured dies while the policy is in force, the death benefit payable is $275,000.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Recipient
facts.sentence: The death benefit is payable to the named beneficiary.

facts.name: Claim Settlement Condition
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary is also a joint owner and survives the insured, the claim payment fully satisfies the insurer’s obligation.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of death is required when filing a claim.

facts.name: Claimant Identity Verification
facts.sentence: Claimant identity must be verified by the insurer.

facts.name: Ownership Verification Requirements
facts.sentence: Documents necessary to establish ownership at the time of claim are required.

facts.name: Claim Payment Discharge
facts.sentence: Claim payment discharges our liability.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: We require proof of death to process a claim.

facts.name: Claimant Identity Verification
facts.sentence: We require claimant identity to process a claim.

facts.name: Proof of Ownership Requirement
facts.sentence: We require documents to establish ownership at the time of claim.

facts.name: Survival-based ROP Payout
facts.sentence: If the insured is alive on April 10, 2046, and the policy is in force, we will pay the then current owner the paid base premiums.

facts.name: Projected Premium Return
facts.sentence: The paid base premiums projected to be paid on April 10, 2046, equal $44,400.

facts.name: ROP Percentage Based on Duration
facts.sentence: If the policy is surrendered before the end of term, the vested Return of Premium (ROP) percentage depends on the number of years the policy has been active.

facts.name: Zero ROP for First Five Years
facts.sentence: For years 1 through 5 of the policy, the vested ROP percentage is 0%.

facts.name: Vested ROP: Years 6–10
facts.sentence: For years 6 through 10 of the policy, the vested ROP percentage is 30%.

facts.name: Vested ROP: 60% (Years 11–15)
facts.sentence: For years 11 through 15 of the policy, the vested ROP percentage is 60%.

facts.name: Vested ROP: 80% (Years 16–18)
facts.sentence: For years 16 through 18 of the policy, the vested ROP percentage is 80%.

facts.name: Vested ROP: Years 19–20
facts.sentence: For years 19 through 20 of the policy, the vested ROP percentage is 100%.

facts.name: Successor Owner Payout Rule
facts.sentence: If one joint owner dies before the insured and no surviving joint owner remains, the vested ROP becomes payable only to the successor owner recorded by us.

facts.name: Refund Exclusion in ROP Calculation
facts.sentence: Any premium not actually paid because of a refund or reversal is excluded from the ROP amount.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: A quarterly premium of $555 is due on April 10 of each policy year.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: A quarterly premium of $555 is due on July 10 of each policy year.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: A quarterly premium of $555 is due on October 10 of each policy year.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: A quarterly premium of $555 is due on January 10 of each policy year.

facts.name: Premium Conversion Option
facts.sentence: Annual conversion of premium mode is allowed upon request.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for premium payment is 31 days after each due date.

facts.name: Late Premium Refund Rate
facts.sentence: A quarterly premium paid more than 20 days late is refunded at the end of the term only at 90% of its original amount.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period is 31 days after each due date.

facts.name: Late Quarterly Premium Refund
facts.sentence: A quarterly premium paid more than 20 days late is refunded at the end of the term only at 90% of the amount paid.

facts.name: Conversion Eligibility Window
facts.sentence: This policy may be converted to permanent insurance before the end of policy year 15.

facts.name: Joint Owner Conversion Signatures
facts.sentence: If joint owners request conversion, both must sign unless only one owner remains of record.

facts.name: Full Conversion Ends ROP
facts.sentence: Full conversion terminates ROP.

facts.name: Partial Conversion & ROP Reduction
facts.sentence: Partial conversion proportionally reduces future ROP.

facts.name: Partial Conversion Impact
facts.sentence: Partial conversion proportionally reduces the face amount.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Authority
facts.sentence: Either joint owner may change the beneficiary unless an irrevocable beneficiary consent is required.

facts.name: Joint Owner Assignment Right
facts.sentence: Either joint owner may assign the policy as collateral unless there is a recorded restriction requiring both signatures.

facts.name: Reliance on Recent Ownership Instructions
facts.sentence: We may rely on the most recent ownership instruction in good faith.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within two years from issue results in returning premiums paid for the base policy.

facts.name: Contestability Clause
facts.sentence: We may contest the policy for material misrepresentation within two years of issue.

facts.name: Marital Status Exclusion Waiver
facts.sentence: No exclusion applies due to a change in marital status.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: We may contest the policy for material misrepresentation within two years of issue.

facts.name: Marital Status Non-Exclusion
facts.sentence: No exclusion applies due to change in marital status.

facts.name: Reinstatement Time Limit
facts.sentence: Reinstatement may be requested within 5 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of arrears with 5% interest.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability satisfactory to us.

facts.name: Ownership Change & Reinstatement Request
facts.sentence: If ownership changed during lapse, the recorded owner at time of reinstatement must request reinstatement.

facts.name: Owner Ownership Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change ownership.

facts.name: Owner can change beneficiary
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiary.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The owner may convert the policy.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Owner chooses premium mode
facts.sentence: The owner may choose premium mode.

facts.name: Written Elections Required
facts.sentence: All elections must be made in writing.

facts.name: Written Election Requirement
facts.sentence: All elections must be made in a form acceptable to us.

facts.name: Age/Sex Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age or sex adjusts insurance to the amount purchasable by the premium actually paid.

facts.name: No Loan Value
facts.sentence: The policy has no loan value.

facts.name: Tax Advice on Joint Premium Returns
facts.sentence: Consult a tax advisor regarding the treatment of returned premiums under joint ownership.

facts.name: Return of Premium on Survival
facts.sentence: If the insured survives the full term of the policy, and all base premiums are paid, 100% of base premiums paid will be returned.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: If the insured dies while the policy is in force, the base death benefit will be paid to the named primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Base Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The base death benefit amount is $310,000.

facts.name: Charitable Legacy Payout Condition
facts.sentence: If the insured dies while the policy is in force, the charitable legacy benefit will be paid to the charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Charitable Legacy Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit amount is $10,000.

facts.name: Charity Benefit Independence
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit does not reduce the base death benefit.

facts.name: Charity Existence Condition
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit is payable only if the named charitable beneficiary, Lakeside Literacy Foundation, exists.

facts.name: Charity Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit is payable only if the named charitable beneficiary, Lakeside Literacy Foundation, is legally able to receive funds.

facts.name: Charity Payment Contingency
facts.sentence: If the named charitable beneficiary cannot accept payment, the charitable legacy benefit is paid to the contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Charitable Legacy Amount
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit is $10,000.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Payment
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit is payable to the charitable beneficiary named in the policy.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Existence Requirement
facts.sentence: The charitable beneficiary must exist in order for the charitable legacy benefit to be paid.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Eligibility
facts.sentence: The charitable beneficiary must be legally able to receive funds in order for the charitable legacy benefit to be paid.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Transfer Rule
facts.sentence: If the named charitable beneficiary cannot accept payment, the charitable legacy benefit is paid to the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Receives Legacy Benefit
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary receives the charitable legacy benefit only if the named charitable beneficiary cannot accept payment.

facts.name: Alternate Charity Override
facts.sentence: An alternate charity designation by the owner overrides the default transfer to the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Claim Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: Standard claim proof is required to process any payout under the policy.

facts.name: Beneficiary Identification Required
facts.sentence: Beneficiary identification is required to process any payout under the policy.

facts.name: Survival Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: If the insured is alive on April 10, 2046, and the policy is in force, the owner will receive $38,500.

facts.name: Survival-based ROP Payout
facts.sentence: The return of premium (ROP) provision applies when the insured survives until April 10, 2046.

facts.name: Surrender Value: Years 1–5
facts.sentence: The surrender value during years 1–5 is 0%.

facts.name: Surrender Value: Years 6–10
facts.sentence: The surrender value during years 6–10 is 30%.

facts.name: Surrender Value: Years 11–15
facts.sentence: The surrender value during years 11–15 is 60%.

facts.name: Surrender Value: Years 16–18
facts.sentence: The surrender value during years 16–18 is 85%.

facts.name: Surrender Value at 100%
facts.sentence: The surrender value during years 19–20 is 100%.

facts.name: Non-refundable Charitable Benefit
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit is not refundable.

facts.name: Charitable Legacy Exclusion
facts.sentence: The charitable legacy benefit is not included in the return of premium (ROP) amount.

facts.name: Rider Premium Exclusion
facts.sentence: Any rider premium is excluded from the ROP calculation.

facts.name: Charitable Charge Exclusion
facts.sentence: Any charitable administration charge is excluded from the ROP calculation.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $1,925.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due each April 10.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for premium payment is 31 days.

facts.name: Reinstatement ROP Credit Reduction
facts.sentence: If a premium is paid after a lapse and the policy is reinstated, the policy year in default earns only 75% ROP credit for that year’s premium.

facts.name: Level Premiums Throughout Term
facts.sentence: Premiums remain level throughout the term of the policy.

facts.name: Reduced ROP Credit for Default Earnings
facts.sentence: Default earnings receive only 75% ROP credit for that year's premium.

facts.name: Level Premium Structure
facts.sentence: Premiums remain level throughout the term.

facts.name: Conversion Before Year 15
facts.sentence: This policy may be converted to permanent insurance before the end of policy year 15.

facts.name: No Evidence Required for Early Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion to permanent insurance prior to the end of policy year 15 does not require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion & Legacy Termination
facts.sentence: Full conversion terminates the charitable legacy feature unless the new policy form includes such feature.

facts.name: Partial Conversion Reduces ROP
facts.sentence: Partial conversion proportionally reduces future ROP.

facts.name: Full Conversion Reduces Future ROP
facts.sentence: Full conversion proportionally reduces future ROP.

facts.name: Owner Changes Charitable Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The owner may change the charitable beneficiary by written request.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Rights Limitation
facts.sentence: The charitable beneficiary has no ownership rights while the insured is living.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Effective Upon Recording
facts.sentence: Any change of charitable beneficiary becomes effective when recorded by the insurer.

facts.name: Change of Beneficiary Conditions
facts.sentence: A change of charitable beneficiary remains subject to any payment made before recording.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue, liability is limited to return of paid base premiums.

facts.name: Suicide Death Exclusion
facts.sentence: No base death benefit is payable if the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion & Legacy Benefit
facts.sentence: No charitable legacy benefit is payable if the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: We may contest this policy for material misrepresentation within two years after issue.

facts.name: Charity Beneficiary Exclusion Rule
facts.sentence: No exclusion applies solely because a beneficiary includes a charity.

facts.name: Charity Beneficiary Exclusion Exception
facts.sentence: A beneficiary that includes a charity triggers no exclusion under the policy.

facts.name: Reinstatement timeframe
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within five years after lapse.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Payment of Overdue Premiums
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of five percent annual interest.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Continuity
facts.sentence: The last recorded charitable beneficiary remains in effect after reinstatement.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Post-Reinstatement
facts.sentence: The last recorded charitable beneficiary can only be changed after reinstatement through formal process.

facts.name: Owner can change beneficiary
facts.sentence: The owner may change the beneficiary.

facts.name: Owner can change charitable beneficiary
facts.sentence: The owner may change the charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Owner May Surrender Policy
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The owner may convert the policy.

facts.name: Policy Change Requirements
facts.sentence: All changes to the policy must be made in writing.

facts.name: Policy Change Recording Requirement
facts.sentence: All changes to the policy must be recorded by Granite Harbor Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: No Loan Value
facts.sentence: This policy has no loan value.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age adjusts benefits to the amount purchasable by the premium paid.

facts.name: Benefit Adjustment for Sex Misstatement
facts.sentence: Misstatement of sex adjusts benefits to the amount purchasable by the premium paid.
